title: Ironband's Compound
wikitext:
[[Image:Ironband's Compound.jpg|thumb|300px|Ironband's Compound]]
'''Ironband's Compound''' lies south of [[Helm's Bed Lake]] in eastern [[Dun Morogh]], and is a base of operations for a band of [[Dark Iron clan|Dark Iron dwarves]] who readily assault anyone unfortunate enough to wander too close. It was formerly inhabited by [[Sturgy Ironband]].

Dwarven [[paladin]]s come to the compound in order to aid a fallen dwarf and secure evidence of the Dark Irons' presence for [[Ironforge]] in {{questlong|Alliance|12|The Tome of Divinity (dwarf 8)|The Tome of Divinity|class=paladin|race=dwarf}}.
